meta.control_note: control is Dolmino-only and matched on TOTAL leg-A tokens, so it sees 2x the Dolmino the document arms do. Reported as rates, never as a separation partner.
meta.seed_caveat: ONE training seed per cell. seed_sweep_v1 measured ~9pp run-to-run SD on this recipe, so an arm gap of that size is not distinguishable from seed noise. Prompts and surfaces are repeated measurements of one trained model, not replications: do not treat them as n.
